label: Diagram 2.10
caption: Diagram 2.10 Dead-end corridors exceeding 4.5m long | Cavity barriers
description: This drawing is a building plan with two parts, labelled a. and b., and a note 'See para 2.28' at the top left. Part a., captioned ''T' junction with main corridor', shows a vertical unshaded corridor with doorways opening onto rooms, joined by a horizontal green-shaded corridor that branches off to the right to form the junction; this green corridor carries three pairs of door symbols, each pair marked 'Fd'. Part b., captioned 'Continuation past stairway', shows a vertical green-shaded corridor containing door symbols marked 'Fd' arranged in pairs and singly, with two stairways drawn to its right at the upper and lower levels. A legend on the right defines 'Fd' as 'Self-closing fire doorsets' and the green square as 'Protected corridor'. The green shading identifies the protected corridor in both parts, while the unshaded areas are rooms and the main corridor.
